visualObservations: Source Noor is clearly identified by a broad green folded beret, blueblack fringe and side hair, amber mediumtan face, ivory short-sleeved coat, plum apron/tie and dark shoes.
The source beret has large flat polygon planes and a sharp layered wedge at the front. The target offers a softer draped crown, clear rounded band, restrained top nub and broad surface transitions.

The target gives hair locks fuller, softer volume; face and hands rounder edge transitions; clothing a readable collar, sleeves/cuffs, straps and pocket. These are useful native modeling improvements rather than obligations to preserve the source's weak geometry or part count.

At logical size the source tie/pocket details are low contrast in the plum mass; sleeve planes are hard and the tiny exposed shoes can merge with the apron. The improved version should retain clear large color blocks while giving these forms enough separation to read.

Rear source hair forms a broad near-black mass with very limited internal form. Side hair retains a clear profile and ear opening; unseen target views should be judged for coherent construction and useful volume, without inventing an unseen reference design.

In hold/load the existing dish sits at lower-face height in S and profile views and is mostly occluded from N. That source attachment arrangement is a contract caveat; new hair, collar or apron geometry should not add material occlusion or detach the visible props.

Warm broad shading, clear palette blocks, soft controlled highlights and clean native silhouettes

The family concept's white toque, brown hair, blue apron and red tie; Noor retains her own green/blueblack/plum identity
